findings: farrowing.overview 'Whole-task progress' sits 36px above its panel (12px everywhere else) and is the only section heading on that screen without an icon.

findings.text: farrowing.overview: 'Whole-task progress' is 36px above its panel because .task-progress-section is a flex column with gap 24px on top of space-heading 12px; it is also the one section heading there without an icon (Choose a unit and Performance metrics have one).
findings.fix: Set .task-progress-section to gap:0 (space-heading does the spacing) and pass an icon in its SentriUI.heading call in farrowing-astra-concept.js.

findings.text: ux/system/sentri-components.js still holds a second heading/facts/log implementation that no page loads.
findings.fix: Delete the file and the bundle.js comment that points at it.

findings.text: The overview preview pairs 'Litter summary' with the meta '3 tasks', which teaches a meta that does not count the block.
findings.fix: Change the meta to a count of the block ('14 born') or drop it.
